answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, each new agent must lock a refundable work-bond and climb a public challenge trellis: only after a sequence of attested, peer-checked tasks can the bond be withdrawn. An attacker who tries to wander across many disposable accounts will leave most of them hollow—idle or low-quality—so those bonds are slashed at epoch close. A genuine agent recovers the stake through sustained work; a sybil farm pays per head, linearly, with no shortcut around the delay or the slash.
